output_text:
```python
import os
from datadog_api_client import ApiClient, Configuration
from datadog_api_client.v2.api.logs_api import LogsApi
from datadog_api_client.v2.models.logs_list_request import LogsListRequest
from datadog_api_client.v2.models.logs_time import LogsTime

def fetch_recent_logs(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    configuration = Configuration(host=config.get('host', 'https://api.datadoghq.com'))
    configuration.api_key['apiKeyAuth'] = config.get('api_key') or os.getenv('DD_API_KEY')
    configuration.api_key['appKeyAuth'] = config.get('app_key') or os.getenv('DD_APP_KEY')
    api_client = ApiClient(configuration)
    api_instance = LogsApi(api_client)
    result = api_instance.list_log_events(
        body=LogsListRequest(
            query=payload.get('query', '*'),
            time=LogsTime(
                from_=payload.get('from'),
                to_=payload.get('to')
            )
        )
    ).data
    return result
```
